Glance 2026.09.15 improves text preview decoding and file updates.

- Keep readable text around isolated undecodable bytes, shown as red hexadecimal boxes. Copying preserves decoded text without inserting the display digits.
- Automatically follow file updates at the bottom of the preview. Scroll up to keep your reading position and return to the bottom to resume following.
- Fix refreshes scrolling through the document or stopping above the final line, including wrapped lines.
- Fix log highlighting failing to return after being switched off and on.
- Make JSON path tooltips reliable and remove the artificial `root` prefix.
- Simplify file monitoring settings and descriptions.
